_inspectorSnowReport.Report: Sunday, April 12, 5:00 a.m. A storm starts to make its way into the mountain today. Winds will increase and snow showers are possible this afternoon with 2-4 inches of snow expected tonight. Today is your last day to ride Sunrise and Summit Express before they close for the season. Summit is likely to close early today due to warming, so make sure to grab your last laps this morning. Link chairlift and Easy Street will be closed through the weekend. Beginners should use the free shuttle to traverse between base areas. Late spring conditions exist, including thin coverage and bare spots, especially on the lower mountain. Advanced skills are required when descending from Apex Express and Powderhorn. Yesterday's Cardboard Derby delivered! Check out Solitude social for amazing clips of the event.
